The issuer’s financial profile is weak: it has negative shareholders’ equity and retained earnings, with total liabilities exceeding total assets, indicating significant balance-sheet stress and elevated solvency risk. Liquidity is also tight (current ratio of 0.92). While it generates positive operating income (EBIT/operating income of 777M), the structural capital deficit points to a credit quality in the distressed, speculative range.

DECISION: CCC-
